paragraphs: The Event Management Website is a static web application developed using HTML and CSS. It is designed to provide users with information about upcoming events, event highlights, galleries, and contact details through a simple and attractive interface. The website demonstrates the basic concepts of front-end web development, including page layout, styling, images, and content organization. This project serves as a beginner-friendly example of creating a responsive and informative event webpage.

Event management websites help organizers share event information with visitors in an organized and visually appealing manner. This project focuses on presenting event details, promotional content, gallery images, and contact information on a single webpage.
The website is built using only HTML and CSS, making it lightweight, easy to understand, and suitable for learning the fundamentals of web development.
